name: LeanKeySwitch
summary: Record 4's code and plans with the served decode's host work trimmed (position plaintexts encoded once at setup, CutMax issued behind the forward, ciphertext frames in place, the next position's patch ahead of its input), Decode-8's SparseB refreshes on the degree-14 EvalMod series (K = 16), a leaner key switch and leaner bootstraps for both tracks; then EvalMod's executor fusions, a third round of key-switch kernels with hoisted rotation sums summed inside the key dots, the replay's copies removed, a rotation's Q rows on a second stream, the decode linears with fewer roundings, a shorter CutMax (11 refreshes per token instead of 13, ln_f folded into the LM head), Decode-8's LayerNorm statistics from one refresh or one complex ladder and its attention ladders over the 16 keys' lanes, raise drops on deliberate refreshes, and a key set of their own (SparseRot keys, StC-first's input stages over 6 special primes, level relinearization keys; every new key under the dense main secret at a modulus of at most the main key's, checked key by key by the entry's client).
